newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates steady in thin trade.

text.p: Bulgaria's interbank deposit rates were steady in thin trade on Thursday, dealers said.
"Demand for funds is very light as banks' lev liquidity is generally high," said a dealer.
Banks channelled free funds into foreign currency buying to profit from higher interest on mark and dollar deposits and compensate for the low demand for levs.
Interbank overnight lev deposit rates have stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually this week against three percent on overnight mark deposits and around five percent on dollar deposits.
Spot week lev rates stood flat at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.10 percent on Wednesday, up from 2.01 percent on Tuesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank simple annual main interest rate has been set at 5.42 percent since Monday, down from 6.12 percent last week. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
